author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am not approving the automation of the evaluation harness. The current process requires every test case to be manually verified and documented before any model change is considered. If we automate the harness without a complete, manually verified test case log for each scenario, we lose the audit trail that proves our compliance with data governance standards. I will refuse to sign off on any deployment that bypasses this manual documentation step. The rigor of the test case log is non negotiable, and I will not cross that line to speed up the weather feature testing.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they will refuse sign-off and will not cross the line to bypass the manual documentation step, defining a strict limit that cannot be traded away for speed.
